column1: # Executed-oracle ground truth for the pure geodesy contracts.
# GENERATED by `cargo xtask oracle-differential`; do not hand-edit.
# Each row was produced by executing the IMMUTABLE v0.3.0 native oracle
# (oracle/libbleradar_core.so) under qemu-aarch64 against a real Android
# Bionic runtime. The compat geodesy differential replays these executed
# outputs against the safe-Rust reconstruction; because the oracle's
# transcendentals are computed by Bionic libm and the reconstruction's by
# the host libm, the two agree to a tiny physical tolerance rather than
# bit-for-bit (haversine metres, bearing degrees), so these contracts stay
# SourceAnalog -- this is broad executed-oracle differential COVERAGE, not
# Columns (all f64 as raw 64-bit hex): GEO  lat1 lon1 lat2 lon2  hcode hbits  bcode bbits
#   bbits = bearing_deg(lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2) -> f64 degrees; hcode/bcode = UniFFI status (0=ok)
